statements.statement: The service is mobile cardiac telemetry, CPT 93229
The claim was denied under CO-197 for failure to obtain required prior authorization
The patient has recurrent episodes of syncope and palpitations
The patient has known atrial fibrillation
The patient has atherosclerotic heart disease
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to correlate intermittent symptoms with underlying arrhythmias
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to assess the efficacy of current rate control management
